fields.name: date
fields.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Date is critical for house cusp calculations as it determines planetary positions used in some house systems.

fields.name: time
fields.description: Birth time in 24-hour HH:MM:SS format. Time is ESSENTIAL for accurate house cusps, and even minutes matter. The Ascendant (1st house cusp) changes roughly every 4 minutes. Without accurate time, house placements will be incorrect.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Birth location latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Location determines the local horizon and meridian, which are fundamental to house division. Higher latitudes cause more distortion in time-based systems like Placidus.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Birth location longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180). Affects local time and horizon calculations for house cusps.

fields.name: timezone
fields.description: Decimal hours from UTC (e.g. -5 for EST, 5.5 for IST, 9 for JST) OR IANA name (e.g. "America/New_York"). IANA resolved to the DST-correct offset for the chart date.

fields.name: houseSystem
fields.description: House system for dividing ecliptic into 12 houses. Placidus (most popular) uses time, Whole Sign (ancient) uses signs, Equal divides from Ascendant. Use "all" to compare all 4 systems side-by-side for educational purposes.
